Core Active Vocabulary (10 items):

tall — with a long body. Example: My sister is tall.
short — not tall. Example: My brother is short.
hair — the threads on your head. Example: She has got long dark hair.
eyes — the parts of the face you see with. Example: She has got green eyes.
blonde — with light yellow hair. Example: She has got blonde hair.
dark — not light in colour. Example: He has got dark hair.
glasses — frames with lenses you wear to see. Example: He wears glasses.
beard — hair on a man's chin. Example: He has got a beard.
handsome — good-looking, about a man. Example: He is tall and handsome.
beautiful — very good-looking. Example: She is beautiful.
